features.name: TextQuest repo governance and protected master flow
acceptance_tests: CI workflow runs on pull requests into master, pushes to master, and manual dispatch

Required PR gate keeps the `PR gate (fmt + clippy + test + python)` name, routes same-repo PRs to self-hosted Windows, routes fork PRs to GitHub-hosted Windows, and still runs on README-only and docs-only changes

README Metrics workflow no longer pushes directly to protected master, and CI/wiki Python setup now uses either runner-local Python or a checksum-verified Python 3.12.10 embeddable ZIP instead of downloading an unchecked Python ZIP
Nightly Release, Release, and Wiki Nightly workflows are hardened for the self-hosted Windows runner without depending on runner-local pwsh or preinstalled toolchains
TextQuest PR manager automation runs every 5 hours against the TextQuest repository checkout on the automation host
python3 scripts/sync_wiki.py --check
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo test
features.notes: TextQuest now documents master as the protected release branch, keeps `PR gate (fmt + clippy + test + python)` as the only required merge check while routing same-repo PRs to the self-hosted Windows runner and fork PRs to GitHub-hosted Windows, uses `actions/setup-python@v6` only on the GitHub-hosted fork path, keeps self-hosted CI/wiki jobs cmd-safe with runner-local Python or a checksum-verified Python 3.12.10 embeddable ZIP fallback, keeps release/nightly/wiki automation out of merge blocking, hardens the self-hosted Windows workflows around cmd-safe gates, pinned CMake setup, git safe.directory bootstrapping, and nightly rustup provisioning, now relies on the existing Nightly Release -> Wiki Nightly workflow_run chain instead of a redundant manual dispatch, surfaces wiki sync commit stderr more clearly, and tracks the scheduled TextQuest PR manager automation that opens, updates, and merges PRs for agent-authored branches.

features.name: Codex-first autonomous issue pipeline
acceptance_tests: Issue template captures Scope, Done when, Verify, Out of scope, and Source docs
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md define the shared autonomous worker contract
Codex issue executor automation is installed on the automation host and claims exactly one eligible issue per run
TextQuest PR manager automation requires merge:auto and refuses human:required, risk:high, or agent:blocked merges
Trusted agent PRs default `merge:auto` unless the PR or linked issue is explicitly blocked by labels
TextQuest PR manager can auto-close stale or superseded trusted agent PRs with a reason comment
Optional Claude GitHub Action only responds to worker:claude or @claude and never merges
python3 scripts/sync_wiki.py --check

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
import yaml
json.loads(pathlib.Path('feature-list.json').read_text())
yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/claude-agent.yml').read_text())
yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path('.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/agent-task.yml').read_text())
print('ok')
PY
features.notes: Repo docs, issue template, worker contract, Claude workflow, and Codex automation files now define the autonomous queue. The installed issue executor currently runs hourly because Codex app automations do not yet support 15-minute cadences. Trusted agent PRs now default `merge:auto` unless explicitly blocked, the Claude worker explicitly trusts the `Copilot` bot actor instead of failing repository-permission lookup for that GitHub App identity, the PR manager is allowed to resolve addressed bot threads plus close stale or superseded agent PRs, the queue now has a deterministic `scripts/reconcile-agent-queue.sh` repair path plus a dedicated issue-queue reconciler automation that adds missing open issues to the roadmap project and aligns `Agent Status` with ready/working/PR/block states, the label workflow now suppresses `agent:ready` while an issue has an open linked PR or active non-ready label state, the `agent:close` workflow can automatically close agent-authored PRs without touching unrelated human PRs, and a master-owned Copilot CI dispatcher can re-dispatch blocked same-repo Copilot PR heads through `CI` until the repository-level skip-approval setting is enabled while skipping workflow-editing PRs, recognizing the current `Copilot` actor name, and isolating per-PR dispatch failures. The `TextQuest Roadmap` project now uses a dedicated `Agent Status` field for queue state so the built-in `Status` field can keep its broader roadmap-progress meaning.

features.name: DLL injection staging hardening
acceptance_tests: prepare_dll rejects non-DLL source paths
prepare_dll validates staging directory is a real directory
Token file helpers reject symlink token paths
features.notes: Preparing for injection now validates source DLL metadata and destination staging directory/file safety before copy; token helper now validates token-directory and token-path symlink safety before writing or reading session tokens. Final injection step now also validates DLL path inputs, bounds-checks path allocation size, frees remote staging memory on write/timeout failures, and avoids the prior manual cleanup leak in timeout handling.
